steps.name: Given "Admin" is signed in as the administrator
Then the administrator session is authenticated
And the administrator session has admin-only access
When "Admin" creates FAQ category with name "E2E Test Category" and description "Category for E2E testing"
Then the response status should be 201
expected 201; response body: {"id":1,"name":"E2E Test Category-mvc168xq3ep","description":"Category for E2E testing","displayOrder":1,"active":true,"updaterId":"E2EADMIN1792219424457","faqs":[]}
And the FAQ category ID is stored for later use
FAQ category id must have been captured
When "Admin" creates FAQ with question "E2E Test Question?" and answer "E2E Test Answer for automated testing."
Then the response status should be 201

expected 201; response body: {"id":1,"question":"E2E Test Question?","answer":"E2E Test Answer for automated testing.","categoryId":1,"categoryName":"E2E Test Category-mvc168xq3ep","displayOrder":1,"active":true,"updaterId":"E2EADMIN1792219424457"}
And the FAQ ID is stored for later use
FAQ id must have been captured
When "Admin" updates the stored FAQ with question "Updated E2E Question?" and answer "Updated E2E Answer."
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"id":1,"question":"Updated E2E Question?","answer":"Updated E2E Answer.","categoryId":1,"categoryName":"E2E Test Category-mvc168xq3ep","displayOrder":0,"active":true,"createdTime":"2026-10-17T06:43:47.830329","lastUpdateTime":"2026-10-17T06:43:47.83962","updaterId":"E2EADMIN1792219424457"}
When "Admin" soft deletes the stored FAQ
Then the response status should be 204
When "Admin" soft deletes the stored FAQ category
Then the response status should be 204
